description:
**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/match_made_in_heaven), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/match_made_heaven) 

**Official Translations:**    
Japanese: [Beltoon](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/match_made_in_heaven), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.jp/ja/comic/match_made_in_heaven)

Since childhood, Saenghyuk had dreamed of becoming independent early. After graduating high school, he dedicated himself solely to learning a trade, and at a young age, he managed to secure both a shop and a living space in Docheon-dong, a once-thriving commercial area.
However, unlike his childhood memories—when the place was even used as a movie set—Docheon-dong had now become a ghost town, completely deserted. The reason? Rumors of a female ghost running across ceilings had emptied out the nearby residential area.
Sure enough, strange and eerie events begin unfolding in Saenghyuk’s own home, as if a ghost were present… and soon, he starts having strangely erotic dreams, the kind only a teenage boy would have…
